checks.detail: Fresh exact-candidate play verified boot, title-to-gameplay, movement, dash, automatic combat, one death/drop/collection, authored drafts, pause, failure result, Retry, the repaired bell, and three dense cohort cycles. Release convergence still lacks hardware qualification and the ordinary complete-victory matrix.

Physical-key W moved the Warden from z=6.00 to z=1.54 with y fixed at 0.05; a later W+Space sequence moved to z=1.17 and visibly traversed anticipation, active and cooldown presentation. Escape paused and resumed cleanly through context-owned input. A gameplay-state gamepad dash receipt was not collected, so the full keyboard-and-gamepad contract is not proven.

Ordinary play produced a stable Warden Lantern receipt containing cooldown_ready, target_selected, authorized, onset, impact, hit_resolution, damage_applied, death_committed, drop_committed, recovery and completed; the run then recorded one defeated enemy, one spawned drop and ordinary collection to experience=1. Audible waveform inspection was not performed, so the complete audiovisual contract remains unproven.

Ordinary Wave 1 reached six validated off-camera enemies and one complete wispbat death/drop lifecycle; dense preparation showed all four roles, bounded telegraph admission, separation registry state and exact cohort replenishment. Each role's full telegraph-to-pool-return lifecycle was not independently exercised.

The 14-entry catalog exposed authored Lantern's Reach and Cinder Pact cards with concrete values. Keyboard and gamepad selection applied atomically and matched projections: pickup reach 1.15→1.50, XP yield 1.00→1.20, damage multiplier 1.00→1.20 and maximum health 100→88; Retry restored defaults. Natural threshold overflow and held-confirm debounce were not fully observed.

Fresh 1920x1080 title, gameplay, dense boss, economy draft, risk/reward draft, pause, failure result and post-Retry frames used authored iconography and matched authoritative fields without clipping at default scale. Fullscreen/windowed and every supported UI scale were not exercised.

Three diagnostic profile resets each returned immediate and next-frame counts to 0 live enemies, bosses, projectiles, pickups, effects, wisp handles, attack ledgers, registered neighbors and audio voices with 40 pooled enemies; ordinary failure-result Retry restored health, pickup/XP modifiers, damage multiplier, weapon ranks, draft ranks, input context and Idle ownership. Three complete ordinary restarts were not run.

Tester-owned source, InputMap, runtime state, node transforms, scene/resource binding, mesh validation, editor/runtime logs and distributed 1280x720 frames were freshly collected from the exact loop-23 candidate. Ordinary input caused the accepted movement, dash, combat, collection, selection, pause/resume and Retry outcomes.

Dense runtime state equipped rank-4 focused_bolt, threat_sweep and persistent_orbit strategies with distinct cadence, geometry and hit-policy receipts, while reset restored the starting lantern. Three uninterrupted ordinary end-of-run build shapes were not completed.

Data resources and runtime state exposed five ordered wave ids, a 32-enemy final-profile roster, Bellkeeper phase 1 and bounded telegraph/crowd work. The ordinary five-wave sequence, elite transition, Bellkeeper phase 2, exactly-once defeat and victory stop were not observed.

Ordinary high-angle play and transform-derived close views show a coherent intact bell with recognizable body, lower flare, jagged cracked lower silhouette, valid textured material, approximately 1.73m bounds, matched 1.8×2.0×1.8 collision and grounded scale. Keeper post, mausoleum, readable lanes and warm-versus-cool cemetery hierarchy remain distinct. The fixed landmark issue is verified.

Seven explicit Warden semantic mappings, dense causal weapon receipts, bounded lights/audio voices, Retry terminal-lease release and Idle reset were observed with clean logs. The required ordinary-route victory-to-Cheer ownership chain was not reached within the bounded closure probe. coverage.baseline.closure_candidate.491221fd860e=insufficient_evidence;

Title, authored upgrade cards, pause, failure result and post-Retry gameplay were navigable with keyboard; risk/reward focus and selection also worked with gamepad-equivalent D-pad and A. Settings persistence, mouse selection, Credits & Notices, victory, and supported UI-scale stress/restoration were not fully exercised.

All three representative cycles prepared 32 enemies plus Bellkeeper and all weapon families; requested/start/minimum/end workloads were 32 with replenishment counts 7, 3 and 2, and every immediate/next-frame reset was isolated at 0 live and 40 pooled. The renderer was Mesa llvmpipe, with observed p95 values 145.36, 147.47 and 149.27ms, so these values are collector-only and cannot qualify player hardware. coverage.baseline.fps_runtime_stutter.6b972c8aebe3=insufficient_evidence;

The focused candidate pass verified selected repaired and changed surfaces, but did not complete three ordinary 420–600 second victories, the ordinary Bellkeeper terminal chain, three natural end-run build shapes, Credits & Notices, or full replay/title coverage.

required_criteria.requirement: Review candidate-bound runtime evidence against the PRD requirements for phase release_convergence.

Use ordinary keyboard and gamepad-equivalent input to verify camera-relative planar movement, collision sliding, visual facing, dash anticipation/invulnerability/recovery/cooldown, high-angle camera framing and clean pause/resume. Judge only behavior introduced by the active phase; reject hidden threats, contradictory velocity, stuck input or camera modes that drift toward FPS/TPS play.

Bind one stable event chain from cooldown and deterministic legal target selection through emitted attack, hit policy, damage, hurt, exactly-once death and drop. Require visible and audible anticipation, onset, impact and recovery without manual-fire drift, duplicate damage, freed targets, inert attacks or presentation disconnected from state.

Exercise active enemy roles from validated off-camera spawn through approach, separation, telegraph, attack, hurt, death, drop and pool return. Reject collision or out-of-bounds spawns, root sliding, static poses, first-frame damage, unreadable overlap, dead actors moving, permanent clumps, blocked escape lanes and stale pooled state.

Verify enemy reward, collection, experience threshold and overflow, one paused three-choice draft, debounced selection, authoritative build mutation and resumed play with an observable changed attack or utility. Reject duplicate drafts, held-confirm double choice, blank/inert cards, false values, lost overflow or gameplay clocks advancing under draft.

Require every introduced health, experience, level, wave/run, weapon, dash and boss field to match authoritative runtime state while leaving the arena readable. Judge native, fullscreen and supported UI scales; reject default fonts, debug labels, text piles, opaque blue/purple blocks, generic rounded cards, clipped controls and top-left-only pages.

From title through gameplay, pause, player failure and retry, verify single authoritative run transitions and a clean baseline after three restarts. Reject stale actors, timers, signals, pools, pause reasons, input ownership, attacks, effects or audio, and any state that requires restarting the application to recover.

Bind black-box ordinary play and white-box authoritative snapshots, events, transforms, animation/audio owners, logs and distributed frames to the exact candidate. Deterministic setup may reach legal branches, but normal runtime systems and input must cause the accepted outcome.

Exercise every weapon and representative upgrade path. Require focused bolts, close sweep and orbiting area control to retain distinct targeting, cadence, geometry, hit policy, feedback and build consequences rather than renamed copies of one projectile.

Verify five data-driven wave states, composition escalation, elite pressure and the Bellkeeper's two phases, telegraphs, summons or lane pressure, recovery window, exactly-once defeat and victory. The director must honor live caps and stop after terminal state.

Compare ordinary runtime views with the frozen Mournlight visual reference. Require one coherent bounded cemetery, grounded collision, keeper post, mausoleum and cracked bell landmarks, clear escape lanes, readable silhouettes, coherent scale/materials and no visible stand-ins.

Inspect accepted component/source values and every active animation state, moonlight/lantern hierarchy, causal bounded VFX and semantic audio layer under real crowd density. Reject unrelated fallback clips, sliding/dead movement, overdark or clipped light, leaked loops, hum, unexpected speech, generic tones and effects that hide telegraphs.

Navigate title, settings, upgrade, pause, death, victory and result pages across the full viewport with mouse, keyboard and gamepad focus. Verify persisted audio/window/UI-scale/effect settings, authored iconography and typography, truthful summaries and clean replay/title flow.

Profile the representative final wave and boss at 1920x1080 with 25-40 ordinary enemies, all weapon families, pickups, animation, VFX, lights, UI and audio. Require stable frame-time distribution, bounded high-churn work and no growth across three complete retries.

Play the complete seven-to-ten-minute title-to-result run, including failure and victory branches, three viable build shapes, statistics, credits/provenance and replay. Reject placeholders, debug presentation, missing required content or unresolved release-relevant regressions.
